Welcome to Julie Donnelly’s Pain-Free Living channel.

With a BS in Interdisciplinary Health Education and a licensed massage therapist, Julie brings 35 years of experience and credibility in transforming pain management. 

She’s been at the forefront of the field, collaborating with experts like Dr. Peter Lin of Baylor College of Medicine. She is widely recognized for developing the Julstro Method of Osteopathic Muscular Therapy and specialized treatments.

Accredited by organizations like NCBTMB/AMTA, Julie is well known for training massage therapists in the Julstro method. 

Whether you’re navigating the aging process, embracing fitness, tackling repetitive job tasks, working at a desk job, or advocating health and wellness,  you'll find transformative techniques, success stories, and educational insights to help you target pain at its source.

Subscribe now and join a community of people who are overcoming pain and improving their quality of life.
